description: Neural/semantic web search — find pages by meaning, not just keywords. Returns title, URL, published date, author, and relevance score. Optionally retrieve clean page text inline. Example: search({ query: "startups building AI agents for customer support", num_results: 10, type: "neural" })

examples.query: recent research on protein folding with diffusion models
startups building AI agents for customer support

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

include_text.description: If true, include the clean parsed page text (up to 2000 chars) for each result. Default false.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 25)

query.description: The search query — describe what you want by meaning, e.g. "recent research on protein folding with diffusion models"

name: search
title: Search
